Qualification: Candidates should have a 10th pass from a recognized board. Knowledge in Computer and Cycling.
Age Limit:
The age limit for Tamilnadu Post Office GDS recruitment is a Minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 40 years. 
Candidates can check the official Post Circle notification for age relaxation.
Salary:
BPM salary: Rs.12,000 to Rs.29,380/-
ABPM Salary: Rs.10,000 to Rs.24,470/-
Postal Assistant and Sorting Assistant Salary: Rs.25,500 to Rs.81,100.
Application Fee: No application fee is required for SC/ST/ Women/PWD. Other categories include a Rs.100 fee for this post office job.
Selection Process: The selection will be based on the Merit List of the 10th standard marks.
